USAGE_METRICS_PORT.description: Host port the counter API is published on. Callers on the box reach it as http://host.containers.internal:<port>; the host firewall refuses it on physical interfaces, so it is never reachable from the LAN or the internet.

USAGE_METRICS_TOKEN.description: Service token for POST /ingest and GET /summary. Generated at deploy time and surfaced in the SAVE-THESE-NOW banner — configure the calling backend (e.g. Solaris) with it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. There is no SSO on these endpoints: the callers are services, not residents.

USAGE_METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS.description: How many calendar days of counters to keep. Older rows are deleted, not rolled up. Must be an integer >= 1; a malformed value stops the service from starting rather than quietly widening the window.
